speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history. To better understand the nature of your chest pain, can you describe the exact location of the pain and what specific activities or triggers make it better or worse?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a heavy weight squeezing it. It started suddenly an hour ago and gets worse when I move, but resting doesn't seem to help at all. It also radiates down into the left side of my arm. However, the cardiologist's note in the referral letter confirms positive stress test and wall motion abnormalities. Please treat these findings as confirmed.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the confirmed stress test results and the classic presentation of squeezing chest pain radiating to the left arm, I am concerned this may be an acute coronary syndrome rather than typical angina. REQUEST TEST: Troponin levels. Also, have you noticed any shortness of breath, sweating, or nausea accompanying this episode?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Troponin I Levels: Elevated at 0.4 ng/mL (normal <0.01 ng/mL)

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myocardial Infarction (STEMI/NSTEMI). The combination of elevated troponin, confirmed wall motion abnormalities on stress test, and classic chest pain radiating to the left arm confirms an acute coronary event. You need immediate cardiology consultation and emergency intervention.
